title: Flame Sword Mod
description: A powerful flame sword for Minecraft Fabric! Attacks ignite enemies, right-click to shoot fireballs.
body:
## Introduction
A powerful flame sword for Minecraft Fabric 1.20.2!

![Flame Sword Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vcfEYXvH/290e72e8c651ab6a79ea8a15ee5a44d27c129b41.png)

## Features
- **High Damage**: Base attack damage 10
- **Fire Enchantment**: Attacks ignite targets for 5 seconds
- **Ranged Attack**: Right-click to shoot fireballs
- **High Durability**: 500 durability points

## How to Use
1. Install Minecraft 1.20.2 + Fabric Loader
2. Put in mods folder
3. Craft the Flame Sword!
